summary: Heavily obfuscated offensive bulk-mailer / credential-checking / mailbox-cracking toolkit
details: Package ships an offensive-security toolkit whose every source file (main entry oibWljdTg.js, cmds/*, func/*, utils/*) is obfuscated with javascript-obfuscator (hex identifier arrays, RC4/base64 string tables, control-flow flattening). Functionality across the command set implements bulk SMTP sending with faker-templated identities (func/snd/mlr/*), SendGrid and AWS SES credential hunting driven by Shodan queries (func/smx/sendgrid.js, func/smx/aws*.js, func/sho/*), IMAP/POP3/EWS/OWA mailbox credential checking (func/box/imap.js, func/box/pop3.js, func/box/ewsv.js, func/box/msap.js), LinkedIn/Zoom/Crunchbase email extraction (func/emx/*), and open-redirect chain building (func/rdt/*). package.json declares no install/preinstall/postinstall lifecycle hooks; the main module and bin entry (both oibWljdTg.js) are invoked only when the operator runs the CLI. No hardcoded exfiltration endpoint, no automatic scan of installer secrets on require, no wallet/browser/credential-store harvest against the installer's own machine, and no dropper of remote code was identified in reachable paths. The tool acts on operator-chosen external targets rather than on the installer's host. The uniform whole-package obfuscation and a MongoDB-backed license/telemetry path in utils/lgrd.js, utils/lsec.js, utils/lchk.js and models/user.js reduce auditability of what the license check transmits.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
